question: Which of the following state governments unveiled a Braille version of the Constitution of India in January 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Maharashtra government unveiled a Braille version of the Constitution of India in January 2021**__.

 __
 
• Maharashtra Social Justice Minister-Dhananjay Munde unveiled the Braille version of the Indian Constitution at an event in Mumbai.
 
• The Braille version of the Constitution has been **prepared on behalf of Thane-based NGO Astitva Foundation**.
 
• A valuable work of making available the Indian Constitution in Braille script for the visually impaired has been done.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The official language of Maharashtra is Marathi.
 
 
• Capital: Mumbai.
 
• State animal: Giant Squirrel.
 
• State bird: Yellow-footed green pigeon.
 
• State tree: Mango.
 
• State flower: Jarul.
